name: Gambling Den
author: Oddisz
description: A back-room gambling den at every port of size 6 or more. Sell surplus hulls for tokens. Play Slots, multi-ball Pachinko, or Blackjack. Pachinko targets hullmods, weapons, or tokens: collect items on exit, while tokens pay immediately. Each ball's weapon reward avoids repeats until its eligible pool runs out. Blackjack has six decks, 3:2 payouts, Hit, Stand, Double, and Split. Hullmod rewards skip blueprints you already know or carry. Pachinko prices, pocket amounts, crate sizes, and slot odds have LunaLib sliders.
